summary: Built a dependency-free static Quote Board app with local favorite persistence, search, favorites-only filtering, README instructions, and an updated improvement log.
final_summary: Implemented the browser-only quote board MVP. Favorite quote IDs are saved in localStorage, search filters by quote text or author, and the favorites-only toggle narrows the board to saved quotes. No implementation bugs were found during validation. Optimizations made: kept the app dependency-free with no build step. Deferred ideas recorded: user-created quotes, import/export, categories, and a denser list view if the quote set grows.
preview_entry: Open index.html directly in a browser. No dev server is required.
